talk.text: Wait. Is that building upside down?
Almost! It's Boston City Hall, from nineteen sixty-eight, shaped like a stepped pyramid turned over.

label.name: Exposed concrete
label.meta: Raw concrete, shaped into huge blocks

talk.text: What's that rough grey stuff it's made of?
Exposed concrete, left raw and shaped into huge, deep blocks.
Is there an open space in the middle?
Yes, an open courtyard, with the sky right overhead.
Why does it look so strange from above?
The shape shows the city government's different jobs, right on the outside.
